name: File Storage & Upload Security Audit Rubric

criteria.name: Magic Byte and MIME-Type Validation
criteria.description: Uploaded files inspected via initial binary bytes (magic numbers) rather than trusting client Content-Type headers or extension.

scale.3: Binary signature checked on streaming header bytes before file acceptance; disallowed types rejected with HTTP 415.
scale.2: MIME type checked, but relies on file extension lookup rather than byte sniffing.
scale.0: No MIME type validation; arbitrary files accepted.

criteria.name: Safe Path Resolution and Traversal Elimination
criteria.description: Files stored under server-generated UUIDs; target path verified inside storage root; zero user-supplied disk paths.

scale.3: UUID storage filenames, strict path confinement verification, and zero direct user filename usage.
scale.2: Sanitized filename used with random suffix, path traversal prevented.
scale.1: Weak sanitization allowing possible path traversal.
scale.0: User-supplied filename written directly to disk without verification.

criteria.name: Upload Size Limits and Streaming Defense
criteria.description: Hard upper size limit enforced during streaming ingest with immediate HTTP 413 rejection on overflow.

scale.3: Streaming byte count enforcement returning HTTP 413 without loading entire oversized payload into memory.
scale.1: Size limit declared in config but not enforced at runtime.
scale.0: No file size limit; vulnerable to disk/memory exhaustion DoS.

criteria.name: SHA-256 Checksums and Antivirus Hook
criteria.description: SHA-256 checksum calculated on ingest and recorded in database; scanner seam / hook point exists for virus scanning.

scale.3: SHA-256 computed on ingest for deduplication/tamper checking, and quarantine hook point implemented.
scale.2: Checksum stored, but scanner seam missing.
scale.1: MD5 checksum used or checksum optional.
